risks: None to participants: the review uses published and registered data only.
consent: Not applicable; no participants are recruited.
data: Extraction forms and the analysis code are kept and shared with the report.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: age and access to smartphones are extracted where reported, because phone prompts may widen gaps for older patients and those without devices.
effectiveness: Informs a purchase decision with a harmonised comparison of strategies.
efficiency: Two reviewers part-time and existing librarian support.
partnerships: Service executive, clinic managers, two people with lived experience of depression treatment who review the plain-language summary.
rebPath: No research ethics review is needed for a review of published studies; the protocol is registered publicly before screening.
limitations: English and French only; heterogeneous definitions; possible single reviewer if the gate is not met.
summary: No ethics review required; equity extraction by age and device access.
